claims: Instrumentation smoke only: one paired architecture task at 100 concepts. No efficiency win or causal efficacy claim. Automatic term coverage is not human semantic correctness.
limitations: Global runtime skills appeared despite private configuration; complete effective prompt unavailable.
Answer-only synthetic runs used explicit unrestricted OS fallback after sandbox mounting failures; no physical isolation claim.
Exact model release, context capacity and peak logical context unavailable.
CLI trace uses context and reads, not command discovery or search; first invented inspect command failed then recovered.
Tool_calls counts shell command groups; a group can hide an earlier failed CLI invocation.

metrics.cost_reason: No dated provider price schedule or per-request bill has been frozen.
metrics.usage_reason: Runtime turn usage; provider per-request billing detail is unavailable unless supplied separately.
metrics.peak_context_reason: Codex JSONL does not expose the full provider request context. File sizes and cumulative input usage are not peak-context measurements.
metrics.tool_latency_reason: Codex command events do not expose command duration.
metrics.actual_loaded_instruction_reason: No full prompt trace was emitted. File inventory is only expected discovery evidence.
metrics.actual_loaded_skill_reason: No native skill registry prompt trace was emitted. Included, shortened and omitted entries cannot be inferred from source files.

machine_grade.correctness_reason: String checks cannot confirm semantic correctness. Two blinded human ratings and adjudication remain pending.

runtime.process_tree_cleanup: SIGKILL to owned process group; descendants that create another group are outside this cleanup boundary
runtime.exact_model_release_reason: Runtime exposes the requested model ID, not a dated underlying release.
runtime.context_limit_reason: Codex exec JSONL did not report selected model context capacity.
runtime.private_home_policy: Fresh directory; blank global AGENTS; auth only; removed after run.
